subject: Plan: Org setup & API key rotation timeline for Helix Health POC
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Helen Park <helen.park@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Helix Health POC org + initial keys

Hi team,

Following up from the final demo yesterday — Helix Health (POC) asked us to stand up a sandbox org so their engineers can begin integration testing next week. Summary / asks: 

- Company: Helix Health (POC)
- Primary contact: Helen Park (helen.park@helixhealth.com)
- Required by: Mon 2026-05-25 (soft) / Wed 2026-05-27 (hard)

Initial deliverables we agreed:
1) A Redwood project/organization named helix-poc-2026 with two environments: dev and test.
2) Create one admin user (helen.park@helixhealth.com) and two developer invites (itops+dev@helixhealth.com).
3) Issue scoped API keys for a service account limited to generation (no billing admin). Keys should be short-lived (30 days) with rotation plan documented.
4) Provide a sample request template and quickstart for their devs (they want cURL + Node).

Attached is the signed SOW and a rough org template. I put the HubSpot deal id in the links. Please pick this up with the Helix contacts; they are sensitive about key scopes and audit logging.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call if useful.

— Dev
Dev Patel | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Helen Park <helen.park@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Helix Health POC org + initial keys

Thanks Dev — picking this up. Below is an implementation checklist and proposed schedule. I’ve also attached the org-setup template for tracking.

Implementation checklist (owner in parentheses):
- Create org helix-poc-2026 with projects: helix-poc-dev, helix-poc-test (Laura)
- Enable tenant-level audit logging and retention 90 days (Laura)
- Create service account "helix-integration-svc" and narrowly scoped API key (Marissa)
- Configure KMS-backed key material and document rotation policy (Marissa)
- Send admin invites and developer invites (Laura)
- Provide quickstart examples and curl/node snippets (Laura)
- Confirm network egress rules / IP allowlist with Helix Ops (Marissa / Helen)

Proposed timeline:
- Today (Wed 5/20): Create org & projects, enable logging.
- Thu 5/21: Create service account + generate initial key (valid 30 days), draft rotation doc.
- Fri 5/22: Invite users and hand over quickstart.
- Mon 5/25: Helix begins integration testing.

Security notes: we will issue a scoped API key that cannot manage billing or rollout. We will enable audit logging for all admin events and set up a read-only view for Helix (they asked for visibility). For KMS, Helix indicated they prefer Redwood-managed keys for the POC; if they shift to customer-managed HSM, we’ll change the onboarding flow.

Action items for Helen: please confirm the two developer emails to invite and whether SSO via SAML will be required for the admin user.

I’ll create the org now and report back with the invite links.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Helen Park <helen.park@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Helix Health POC org + initial keys

Quick note — I will own the service account and key lifecycle. A couple of implementation details to flag here: 

- Initial key will be generated with the minimal scope: "generation:write" and "generation:read" for helix-poc-dev only. No admin scopes.
- We will add a tag on the key referencing the HubSpot deal id for easy cost attribution.
- By default we will set key expiry at 30 days; I recommend rotating every 14 days for the POC if Helix prefers higher security — we can automate that after the POC.
- I’ll also run a short audit after key issuance to confirm there are no unused permissions.

If Helen confirms the two dev emails I’ll generate the key on Thu 5/21 morning and post a single-use download URL for ingestion.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Helen Park <helen.park@helixhealth.com>

- Dev emails: dev_jason@helixhealth.com, dev_amy@helixhealth.com (please invite both).
- We prefer the admin user to use SAML SSO; we can provide metadata by EOD 5/21 if that works for your timeline.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if easier.

Regards,
Helen Park
Head of Platform Integrations | Helix Health
helen.park@helixhealth.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Helix Health POC org + initial keys

Thanks Helen — that works. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Invites: I’ve sent admin invite to helen.park@helixhealth.com (SSO pending metadata). Dev invites sent to dev_jason@helixhealth.com and dev_amy@helixhealth.com (they will receive a one-time magic link).
- Key scope will be limited to generation and embeddings for helix-poc-dev only. Marissa is issuing the initial key Thu morning (5/21).
- Rotation workflow (short):
  1. Marissa generates a new key and tags it with the deal id.
  2. Marissa posts the single-use key download to the secure URL (expires in 24 hours).
  3. Helix engineers swap the key in their local config / CI secrets.
  4. After Helix confirms success, Marissa revokes the old key.

Automated rotation: we can schedule automated rotations, but they are implemented as overlapping keys (new key active before old key revoked) to avoid downtime for long-lived sessions. For the POC we’ll do manual rotation to keep control.

Links: Quickstart + request examples are in the shared drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HelixOnboard). DocuSign SOW is completed (attached). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345HW.

Action items: 
- Marissa: generate key Thu 5/21 morning and post secure download.
- Laura: confirm SSO metadata and finalize invite permissions.
- Dev: keep the internal escalation path open if any quota issues surface during testing.

I’ll post the invite receipts and key URL once Marissa creates them.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
